\section[\texorpdfstring{\gu{સ્કૂટર} (skūṭar)}{સ્કૂટર (skūṭar)}]{\gu{સ્કૂટર} (skūṭar) — a scooter}

\label{lesson:GU-C400-skutar}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Gujarati for to be averted, then the Gujarati for a peep.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \gu{સ્કૂટર}}
\textbf{\gu{સ્કૂટર}} — \emph{skūṭar} — \textquotedblleft{}a scooter\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\gu{મારા} \gu{ભાઈ} \gu{પાસે} \gu{લાલ} \gu{સ્કૂટર} \gu{છે}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{mārā bhāī pāse lāl skūṭar che.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
My brother has a red scooter.
\end{quote}

A neuter noun.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\gu{સ્કૂટર}} (\emph{skūṭar}) is borrowed from English \emph{scooter}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for getting around.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{skūṭar}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{mārā bhāī pāse lāl skūṭar che.} — My brother has a red scooter.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Gujarati for to be averted, then the Gujarati for a peep, then say \emph{skūṭar} again
\end{itemize}

\label{lesson:GU-C400-hendal}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Gujarati for a helmet, then the Gujarati for a vehicle horn.

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \gu{હેન્ડલ}}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\gu{ઉછાળવું} (uchāḷvũ)}{ઉછાળવું (uchāḷvũ)}]{\gu{ઉછાળવું} (uchāḷvũ) — to toss (up); to throw up in the air}

\label{lesson:GU-C400-uchalvu-toss}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Gujarati for a vehicle horn, then the Gujarati for a handlebar.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \gu{ઉછાળવું}}
\textbf{\gu{ઉછાળવું}} — \emph{uchāḷvũ} — \textquotedblleft{}to toss (up); to throw up in the air\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\gu{બાળક} \gu{દડો} \gu{ઉપર} \gu{ઉછાળે} \gu{છે}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{bāḷak daḍo upar uchāḷe che.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The child tosses the ball up.
\end{quote}

Past, with \gu{તેણે} (he or she …): \gu{તેણે} \gu{દડો} \gu{ઉછાળ્યો}, \emph{teṇe daḍo uchāḷyo}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\gu{ઉછાળવું}} (\emph{uchāḷvũ}) goes back to \emph{*ut-śālayati}, \textquotedblleft{}throws up\textquotedblright{}, a form CDIAL reconstructs; CDIAL lists the Gujarati verb (CDIAL 1848). \gu{ઊછળવું}, to bounce, is its intransitive partner.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for getting around.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}

\raggedright

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bāḷak daḍo upar uchāḷe che.} — The child tosses the ball up.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Gujarati for a vehicle horn, then the Gujarati for a handlebar, then say \emph{uchāḷvũ} again
\end{itemize}

\section[(dialogue)]{Looking back: from Engines and Lines to Scooters and Helmets}

\label{lesson:GU-R400-review-393-400}



\begin{quote}
Say the Gujarati for an engine (of a train) and a railway line.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an engine (of a train), a railway line, a junction (of railway lines), a whistle, to couple
  \item a porter, a trunk (a large box), a bundle (tied in cloth), to slide (something), to catch hold of
  \item a berth (on a train), a reservation (of a seat), food packed for a journey, to cram, to seat
  \item a guard, a lantern, a chain, to ring, a large bell
  \item a commotion, a threshold (of a door), a low wooden seat, to shove, to fill up
  \item a nap, a sleepless night, to be asleep, a jolt, to rattle
  \item a delay, to be heard, a public announcement, to be averted, a peep
  \item a scooter, a helmet, a vehicle horn, a handlebar, to toss
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An engine (of a train)? (\textbf{\gu{એન્જિન}}, \emph{enjin}.) A railway line? (\textbf{\gu{લાઈન}}, \emph{lāīn}.) A junction (of railway lines)? (\textbf{\gu{જંકશન}}, \emph{jankśan}.) A whistle? (\textbf{\gu{સીટી}}, \emph{sīṭī}.) To couple? (\textbf{\gu{જોડવું}}, \emph{joḍvũ}.) A porter? (\textbf{\gu{હમાલ}}, \emph{hamāl}.) A trunk (a large box)? (\textbf{\gu{પટારો}}, \emph{paṭāro}.) A bundle (tied in cloth)? (\textbf{\gu{પોટલું}}, \emph{poṭlũ}.) To slide (something)? (\textbf{\gu{સરકાવવું}}, \emph{sarkāvvũ}.) To catch hold of? (\textbf{\gu{ઝાલવું}}, \emph{jhālvũ}.) A berth (on a train)? (\textbf{\gu{બર્થ}}, \emph{barth}.) A reservation (of a seat)? (\textbf{\gu{રિઝર્વેશન}}, \emph{rijharveśan}.) Food packed for a journey? (\textbf{\gu{ભાથું}}, \emph{bhāthũ}.) To cram? (\textbf{\gu{ઠાંસવું}}, \emph{ṭhā̃svũ}.) To seat? (\textbf{\gu{બેસાડવું}}, \emph{besāḍvũ}.) A guard? (\textbf{\gu{ગાર્ડ}}, \emph{gārḍ}.) A lantern? (\textbf{\gu{ફાનસ}}, \emph{phānas}.) A chain? (\textbf{\gu{સાંકળ}}, \emph{sā̃kaḷ}.) To ring? (\textbf{\gu{વાગવું}}, \emph{vāgvũ}.) A large bell? (\textbf{\gu{ઘંટ}}, \emph{ghanṭ}.) A commotion? (\textbf{\gu{ધમાલ}}, \emph{dhamāl}.) A threshold (of a door)? (\textbf{\gu{ઉંબરો}}, \emph{umbro}.) A low wooden seat? (\textbf{\gu{પાટલો}}, \emph{pāṭlo}.) To shove? (\textbf{\gu{હડસેલવું}}, \emph{haḍselvũ}.) To fill up? (\textbf{\gu{ભરાવું}}, \emph{bharāvũ}.) A nap? (\textbf{\gu{ઝોકું}}, \emph{jhokũ}.) A sleepless night? (\textbf{\gu{ઉજાગરો}}, \emph{ujāgro}.) To be asleep? (\textbf{\gu{ઊંઘવું}}, \emph{ū̃ghvũ}.) A jolt? (\textbf{\gu{ઝટકો}}, \emph{jhaṭko}.) To rattle? (\textbf{\gu{ખખડવું}}, \emph{khakhaḍvũ}.) A delay? (\textbf{\gu{વિલંબ}}, \emph{vilamb}.) To be heard? (\textbf{\gu{સંભળાવું}}, \emph{sambhḷāvũ}.) A public announcement? (\textbf{\gu{એલાન}}, \emph{elān}.) To be averted? (\textbf{\gu{ટળવું}}, \emph{ṭaḷvũ}.) A peep? (\textbf{\gu{ડોકિયું}}, \emph{ḍokiyũ}.) A scooter? (\textbf{\gu{સ્કૂટર}}, \emph{skūṭar}.) A helmet? (\textbf{\gu{હેલ્મેટ}}, \emph{helmeṭ}.) A vehicle horn? (\textbf{\gu{હોર્ન}}, \emph{horn}.) A handlebar? (\textbf{\gu{હેન્ડલ}}, \emph{henḍal}.) To toss? (\textbf{\gu{ઉછાળવું}}, \emph{uchāḷvũ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
